_comment: S3 lifecycle rules: what deletes old backups. The backup job never does —
it holds PutObject only, so a leaked key cannot destroy the history.
Remove this _comment key first — the S3 API rejects unknown fields.
Retention: 30 daily, 12 monthly, 3 years of annual snapshots. Days are
counted from when an object is created, so the monthly rule is 395 days
(13 months) rather than 365: a backup taken on 1 January must survive
until the one taken on 1 January the following year exists, or you would
AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload matters more than it looks. A failed
upload leaves parts that are invisible in the console but still billed,
for as long as the bucket exists.
